scope: Jetour Egyptian models T1 T2 Dashing actual OEM catalogue, avoid misleading comparison of 1.5T and 1.6T by displacement alone
method: Manual editorial review against primary Egypt-market catalogue evidence, not official Google rating; facts and model-specific diagnostics determine changes, not word count.

findings: Initial source lacks source-level differentiation of currently sold T1/T2/X70 powertrains and VIN-specific cases; requires manufacturer catalogue audit before changes.

Current Jetour Egypt official T1 page and PDF says 1.5T 184 hp/290 Nm; T2 lists 1.5T 184 hp and 2.0T 254 hp; Dashing Egypt PDF gives distinct 1.5T 156 PS and 1.6T 197 PS. Distinguish them rather than asserting a universal 1.5T spec.
Missing tests for underboost P0299, misfire, fuel trims, wet DCT by actual variant and voltage-diagnostic priority.
